name: Tony Hawk Slop Skater
author: DarthSully
description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater (PS1, 1999) running natively on the PlayStation Vita, built from the community decompilation of the PS1 game (SLUS-00860): the PS1's own code, recompiled for the Vita's ARM CPU, with a native OpenGL ES renderer through vitaGL. No emulator.
